text: Detection on the robot: find and decode markers in the head camera image (zoom stills where needed), estimate the 6-DoF pose from the known size and intrinsics, transform into map via TF, create/update the matching POI (kind, pose, metadata, last-seen, confidence); repeated sightings refine, not duplicate; nothing published without real detections.
POI kinds include base, charger, drop-off container, button/switch and tool change station (extensible); the agent can list marker POIs and use them as targets.
READMEs, tests and deployment of the detection part; verified on the robot with printed markers at known poses.
Metadata in the marker allows automatic POI conversion and states its size (always square).
A detected marker's orientation, placement and metadata automatically become a POI.
Example kinds: base, charger, drop-off container, button/switch marker, tool change station (extensible).
